BaseUrl.description: Optional absolute base URL of the site, for example 'https://www.example.com'. A relative URL is rejected; an empty value or null clears it.

Calendar.description: Optional calendar system identifier used by the site.

MaxPagedCount.description: Maximum number of items Orchard may return from paged queries.

MaxPageSize.description: Maximum page size allowed by Orchard paging APIs.

PageSize.description: Default page size used by Orchard lists and queries.

AllowPageSizeSelection.description: Whether admin lists show a selector that lets users pick the page size from PageSizeOptions.

PageSizeOptions.description: The page sizes offered when AllowPageSizeSelection is true. Defaults to [10, 25, 50, 100].

ResourceDebugMode.description: Controls whether resource debugging stays with configuration, is forced on, or is forced off.

PageTitleFormat.description: Page title format string, typically including placeholders like '{{ Site.SiteName }}'.

SiteSalt.description: Application salt used by Orchard security and hashing features.

SuperUser.description: User name of the Orchard super user account.

UseCdn.description: Whether Orchard should serve static assets from a CDN base URL.

CdnBaseUrl.description: Absolute CDN base URL used when UseCdn is enabled, for example 'https://cdn.example.com'. A relative URL is rejected; an empty value or null clears it.

AppendVersion.description: Whether Orchard should append file version hashes to resource URLs.

HomeRoute.description: Optional route object that overrides the site's home page target.

CacheMode.description: Controls Orchard cache behavior for the tenant.

AIChatAdminWidgetSettings.description: Configuration for the AI chat widget displayed in the admin dashboard.

ProfileId.description: The AI profile identifier used by the admin chat widget.

MaxSessions.description: The maximum number of concurrent chat sessions allowed.

PrimaryColor.description: The primary color for the chat widget UI.

AIContactMemorySettings.description: How the AI rewrites a CRM contact's memory note after each conversation.

Instructions.description: The instructions the memory writer follows. Empty uses the built-in instructions.

AICostSettings.description: What the phone lines cost, used to estimate the cost of each AI call. What the AI costs is set on each AI deployment (its Pricing).

Currency.description: The ISO currency code the carrier's prices are in, such as USD.

TelephonyPerMinute.description: What a minute of a phone call costs with the carrier.

SmsPerMessage.description: What one text message costs with the carrier.

AIDataSourceSettings.description: Default configuration for AI data source retrieval behavior.

DefaultStrictness.description: The default strictness level for data source queries (higher values are more strict).

DefaultTopNDocuments.description: The default number of top documents to retrieve from data sources.

AIMemorySettings.description: Configuration for AI memory storage and retrieval.

IndexProfileName.description: The name of the index profile used for memory storage.

TopN.description: The maximum number of memory entries to retrieve per query.

AIVisitorIdentityOptions.description: Configuration for anonymous AI chat visitor identity and remote-address handling.

CookieName.description: The cookie name used to persist the anonymous visitor identifier.

CookieLifetime.description: The visitor cookie lifetime as a .NET TimeSpan string.

AllowCrossSiteEmbedding.description: Whether the visitor cookie is written SameSite=None; Secure so it survives inside a frame on another site. A request that did not arrive over HTTPS keeps the SameSite=Lax cookie either way.

UsePartitionedCookie.description: Whether the visitor cookie carries the Partitioned attribute while AllowCrossSiteEmbedding is on, which keeps the cookie written in a frame apart from the first-party one of the same name.

RemoteAddressHashSalt.description: The application-specific salt used when hashing remote addresses.

AbstractApiPhoneNumberVerificationSettin.description: The AbstractAPI phone number verification provider.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the provider is enabled and can be selected to verify phone numbers.

AuthenticationType.description: How the provider authenticates: with the API key, or with a user name and password.

ProtectedApiKey.description: The API key, used with ApiKey authentication. The Settings step stores it exactly as given, so it must already be encrypted by the destination tenant with the 'PhoneNumberVerifications.AbstractApi' data protection purpose; a clear-text value cannot be read. Prefer entering it on the settings screen.

Username.description: The user name, used with Basic authentication.

ProtectedPassword.description: The password, used with Basic authentication. The Settings step stores it exactly as given, so it must already be encrypted by the destination tenant with the 'PhoneNumberVerifications.AbstractApi' data protection purpose; a clear-text value cannot be read. Prefer entering it on the settings screen.

AdminSettings.description: Configuration for the admin dashboard appearance and behavior.

DisplayThemeToggler.description: Whether to display the light/dark theme toggler in the admin.

DisplayMenuFilter.description: Whether to display the menu filter input in the admin navigation.

DisplayQuickNavigation.description: Whether to display the quick navigation palette (Ctrl+K / Cmd+K) in the admin navbar.

DisplayNewMenu.description: Whether to display the 'New' menu in the admin navigation.

DisplayTitlesInTopbar.description: Whether to display page titles in the top bar.

ShowBreadcrumb.description: Whether to display the breadcrumb trail above admin page titles.

MenuBehavior.description: How the sections of the admin menu open and close.

ListLayout.description: The layout of admin lists. When omitted, AdminListOptions.DefaultLayout is used.

ActionsLayout.description: The layout of the row actions of admin lists and of the secondary actions of the bottom action bar of edit pages. When omitted, AdminListOptions.DefaultActionsLayout is used.

AllowUserListLayoutSelection.description: Whether each admin list shows a layout selector whose choice is kept per user, per list, in a cookie.

AsteriskSettings.description: Asterisk provider settings for the tenant-configured ARI connection.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the tenant-configured Asterisk provider is enabled.

BaseUrl.description: Base URL of the Asterisk ARI endpoint.

Password.description: ARI password. Secret: stored exactly as given, so it must already be data-protected by the destination tenant. Prefer the provider's own recipe step, which takes the value in clear text and protects it.

ApplicationName.description: Stasis application name used for originated channels.

EndpointTemplate.description: Optional template that turns a dialed destination into an ARI endpoint; use the {number} token for the destination.

OutboundCallerId.description: Caller identifier presented on outbound calls.

VoicemailContext.description: Dialplan context a call continues into when an agent sends an inbound offer to voicemail.

VoicemailExtensionTemplate.description: Template that resolves the voicemail dialplan extension; it may use tokens such as {voicemailRecipientUserName} or {calledAddress}.

VoicemailPriority.description: Dialplan priority used when continuing a call to voicemail.

WebSocketUrl.description: Secure WebSocket URL browser SIP user agents connect to.

SipDomain.description: SIP domain used to compose browser agent addresses of record.

TurnUrls.description: Comma- or newline-delimited STUN/TURN URLs advertised to browser agents.

TurnSharedSecret.description: coturn REST shared secret used to issue time-limited TURN credentials. Secret: stored exactly as given, so it must already be data-protected by the destination tenant. Prefer the provider's own recipe step, which takes the value in clear text and protects it.

IceTransportPolicy.description: ICE transport policy sent to the browser, for example 'all' or 'relay'.

WebRtcCodecs.description: Comma- or newline-delimited browser audio codec preference list, for example 'opus,g722,ulaw'.

PjsipCredentialLifetimeMinutes.description: Lifetime, in minutes, of the short-lived PJSIP credentials issued to browser agents.

PjsipRealtimeProviderInvariantName.description: ADO.NET provider invariant name used to write PJSIP Realtime rows.

PjsipRealtimeConnectionString.description: PJSIP Realtime database connection string. Secret: stored exactly as given, so it must already be data-protected by the destination tenant. Prefer the provider's own recipe step, which takes the value in clear text and protects it.

AuditTrailSettings.description: Configuration for audit trail event recording.

Categories.description: The list of audit trail event category configurations.

IsEnabled.description: Whether this event is enabled for recording.

ClientIpAddressAllowed.description: Whether to record the client IP address in audit trail entries.

AuditTrailTrimmingSettings.description: Configuration for automatic trimming of old audit trail entries.

RetentionDays.description: The number of days to retain audit trail entries before trimming.

AuthenticatorAppLoginSettings.description: Configuration for authenticator app two-factor authentication.

UseEmailAsAuthenticatorDisplayName.description: Whether to use the user's email as the authenticator app display name.

TokenLength.description: The length of the verification token.

AzureADSettings.description: Configuration for Azure Active Directory authentication.

DisplayName.description: The display name for the Azure AD login provider.

AppId.description: The Application (client) ID from Azure AD app registration.

TenantId.description: The Directory (tenant) ID from Azure AD.

CallbackPath.description: The request path within the application's base path where the user-agent will be returned after sign-in.

SaveTokens.description: Whether to save the access and refresh tokens in the authentication properties.

AzureAISearchDefaultSettings.description: Configuration for Azure AI Search connection defaults.

UseCustomConfiguration.description: Whether to use custom configuration instead of the default.

AuthenticationType.description: The authentication type for Azure AI Search.

Endpoint.description: The Azure AI Search service endpoint URL.

ApiKey.description: The Azure AI Search API key, protected with the tenant's ASP.NET Core Data Protection keys. A clear value does not work. In recipes, set 'ApiKeySecretName' instead.

ApiKeySecretName.description: The name of the secret (OrchardCore.Secrets feature) that holds the Azure AI Search API key. When it is set, it takes precedence over the protected value. Create the secret with the 'Secrets' recipe step.

IdentityClientId.description: The client ID of the managed identity to use.

AzureEmailSettings.description: Configuration for the Azure Communication Services email provider.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the Azure email provider is enabled.

ConnectionString.description: The Azure Communication Services connection string, protected with the tenant's ASP.NET Core Data Protection keys. A clear value does not work. In recipes, set 'ConnectionStringSecretName' instead.

ConnectionStringSecretName.description: The name of the secret (OrchardCore.Secrets feature) that holds the Azure Communication Services connection string. When it is set, it takes precedence over the protected value. Create the secret with the 'Secrets' recipe step.

AzureMapsSettings.description: The Azure Maps provider's settings. Choose the provider in GeoSettings.

Key.description: The API key, stored encrypted with this tenant's data protection keys. A plain key written by the Settings step can't be read back, so enter the key in the admin under Settings > Maps and Geocoding instead.

AzureSmsSettings.description: Configuration for the Azure Communication Services SMS provider.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the Azure SMS provider is enabled.

ConnectionString.description: The Azure Communication Services connection string, protected with the tenant's ASP.NET Core Data Protection keys. A clear value does not work. In recipes, set 'ConnectionStringSecretName' instead.

ConnectionStringSecretName.description: The name of the secret (OrchardCore.Secrets feature) that holds the Azure Communication Services connection string. When it is set, it takes precedence over the protected value. Create the secret with the 'Secrets' recipe step.

PhoneNumber.description: The phone number to send SMS messages from.

BankTransferSettings.description: The site settings of the Bank transfer payment method: whether it is offered, how to pay, and when it is due.

Enabled.description: Whether Bank transfer is offered at checkout. Off until the store adds its bank details.

Instructions.description: How to pay, shown at checkout, on the confirmation and on the order's page: the store's bank account details, for example.

NetTermDays.description: How many days after checkout the transfer is due. 0 records the balance without a due date.

CanadaDnclRegistrySettings.description: Configuration for the Canada LNNTE-DNCL Registry provider.

ProtectedApiKey.description: The encrypted API key used to authenticate with the Canada LNNTE-DNCL Registry.

AccountNumber.description: The Canada LNNTE-DNCL account number used for registry lookups.

BaseUrl.description: The base URL for the Canada LNNTE-DNCL Registry API.

CarrierProviderSettings.description: Which carrier provider the store uses, on the Providers tab of Settings › Commerce › Shipping.

DefaultProviderName.description: The technical name of the default carrier provider, or null for none.

CashOnDeliverySettings.description: The site settings of the Cash on delivery payment method.

Enabled.description: Whether Cash on delivery is offered, on checkouts of orders that are delivered.

Instructions.description: What the buyer is told at checkout, for example which payments the courier takes.

ChangeEmailSettings.description: Configuration for the change email feature.

AllowChangeEmail.description: Whether to allow users to change their email address.

ChatInteractionChatModeSettings.description: Configuration for the default chat interaction mode.

ChatMode.description: The default chat input mode for interactions.

EnableTextToSpeechPlayback.description: Whether to enable text-to-speech playback of AI responses.

CheckoutSettings.description: The site-level settings that govern checkout behavior across every checkout scenario.

DefaultPaymentMethod.description: The key of the payment provider selected by default when a checkout offers more than one.

Currency.description: The default ISO-4217 currency used when a checkout does not specify one.

SessionLifetimeHours.description: How long an unpaid checkout is kept before it expires and whatever the provider was holding for it is released. Defaults to one day.

Layout.description: How the checkout's steps are laid out: a page per step, or all on one page.

ClaudeSettings.description: Configuration for the Claude AI chat integration.

AuthenticationType.description: The authentication method used by the Claude integration.

BaseUrl.description: The base URL for the Claude API.

ProtectedApiKey.description: The encrypted API key for the Claude provider.

DefaultModel.description: The default Claude model to use for interactions.

ContactCenterDefaultAddressSettings.description: The numbers used when an agent has none of their own: the number calls are placed from and the number texts are sent from.

DefaultPhoneAddressId.description: The ItemId of the phone channel endpoint (see the OmnichannelChannelEndpoint step) calls are placed from by default.

DefaultSmsAddressId.description: The ItemId of the SMS channel endpoint (see the OmnichannelChannelEndpoint step) texts are sent from by default.

ContactCenterExternalTransferSettings.description: The operator-curated catalog of approved external transfer destinations.

Id.description: Opaque stable identifier callers supply when requesting a transfer to this destination.

DisplayName.description: Operator-assigned display name of the destination.

E164Address.description: Canonical E.164 address the call is transferred to.

Enabled.description: Whether the destination is active. Disabled destinations are always denied.

Destinations.description: Approved external destinations. Only entries that are present and enabled are reachable by an external transfer.

AllowUnlistedNumbers.description: Whether an agent who may transfer externally may also dial a number that is not in 'Destinations'. The number must still pass the platform's dial policy.

ContactCenterRecordingSettings.description: Recording governance policy every Contact Center voice interaction must satisfy.

RecordAllCalls.description: Whether every call is recorded automatically while the Call Recording feature is enabled: a Contact Center call when it connects to an agent, an AI voice agent's call when it is answered, and a number dialed on the soft phone keypad when it is answered.

ConsentModel.description: Consent model that governs whether a call may be recorded: every party must consent, or the recording organization's consent is sufficient.

RequireExplicitConsent.description: Whether consent must be captured on the interaction before recording may start. Giving the recording disclosure captures it.

EnableRecordingDisclosure.description: Whether callers are told the call is recorded, using RecordingDisclosureText.

RecordingDisclosureText.description: The notice callers are given that the call is recorded, spoken word for word by the platform or read out by the agent.

DiscloseOnInboundCalls.description: Whether the disclosure is spoken to an inbound caller on an entry point before its welcome message, menu or queue.

DiscloseOnAIVoiceCalls.description: Whether an automated voice agent gives the disclosure before anything else it says.

PromptAgentsToDisclose.description: Whether an agent on a call whose caller has not heard the disclosure is shown it to read out and confirm.

RetentionDays.description: Days a recording is retained before it becomes eligible for erasure. Zero retains recordings indefinitely.

LegalHoldByDefault.description: Whether captured recordings begin under legal hold, which exempts them from retention-driven and subject-request erasure until released.

AllowAgentSecurePause.description: Whether an agent may pause and resume recording on their own live interaction from the agent desktop.

MaxSecurePauseSeconds.description: Longest time, in seconds, a recording may stay paused before it resumes automatically. Zero applies no automatic resume.

RequirePauseReason.description: Whether an agent must supply a reason when pausing recording.

ContentAuditTrailSettings.description: Configuration for content-specific audit trail tracking.

AllowedContentTypes.description: The content types to track in the audit trail.

ContentCulturePickerSettings.description: Configuration for the content culture picker behavior.

RedirectToHomepage.description: Whether to redirect to the homepage when switching cultures.

SetCookie.description: Whether to set a cookie to remember the selected culture.

ContentRequestCultureProviderSettings.description: Configuration for the content request culture provider.

SetCookie.description: Whether to set a cookie with the determined culture.

CopilotSettings.description: Configuration for the GitHub Copilot-style chat experience.

AuthenticationType.description: The authentication method used by the Copilot integration.

ClientId.description: The OAuth Client ID for GitHub OAuth authentication.

Scopes.description: The OAuth scopes requested during authentication.

ProviderType.description: The AI provider type (e.g., OpenAI, Azure).

BaseUrl.description: The base URL for the AI provider API.

ProtectedApiKey.description: The encrypted API key for the AI provider.

WireApi.description: The wire API protocol to use for communication.

DefaultModel.description: The default AI model to use for Copilot interactions.

AzureApiVersion.description: The Azure OpenAI API version when using Azure as the provider.

CustomerCheckoutSettings.description: What an order's checkout asks the buyer, under Settings › Commerce › Customers.

BillingAddress.description: Whether the checkout asks for a billing address. A checkout keeps the setting it started with.

CustomerPrivacySettings.description: How long the store keeps guests' personal data, under Settings › Commerce › Customers. Zero keeps it.

InactiveGuestMonths.description: The months after a guest customer's last activity when their personal data is erased.

GuestOrderMonths.description: The months after a guest's order was placed when its name, email, phone and billing address are removed. The lines, totals and dates stay.

DefaultAIDeploymentSettings.description: Default AI deployment assignments for each capability type.

DefaultChatDeploymentName.description: The technical name of the default chat deployment.

DefaultUtilityDeploymentName.description: The technical name of the default utility deployment.

DefaultEmbeddingDeploymentName.description: The technical name of the default embedding deployment.

DefaultImageDeploymentName.description: The technical name of the default image generation deployment.

DefaultVisionDeploymentName.description: The technical name of the default vision deployment.

DefaultSpeechToTextDeploymentName.description: The technical name of the default speech-to-text deployment.

DefaultTextToSpeechDeploymentName.description: The technical name of the default text-to-speech deployment.

DefaultTextToSpeechVoiceId.description: The voice identifier to use for text-to-speech.

DefaultRealtimeDeploymentName.description: The technical name of the default realtime deployment: the model that carries a spoken conversation, in the chat or on a phone call, when the profile names none.

DefaultRealtimeVoiceId.description: The voice used in realtime (speech-to-speech) sessions when the profile names none.

DefaultOrchestratorSettings.description: Default configuration for the AI chat orchestrator.

EnablePreemptiveRag.description: Whether to enable preemptive retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in chat sessions.

DispatchSettings.description: How visits are scheduled and dispatched: the objective, arrival windows, travel, customer notices and visits at risk.

CreateVisitsForNewWorkOrders.description: Whether a new work order gets an unscheduled visit. Defaults to true.

ArrivalWindowMinutes.description: The length of the arrival window promised to the customer, in minutes. Defaults to 120.

HorizonDays.description: How many days ahead candidates are looked for. Defaults to 7.

BufferMinutes.description: The minutes kept free between two visits on top of the travel. Defaults to 10.

StrictTerritory.description: Whether a worker must belong to the visit's territory.

TimeZoneId.description: The IANA time zone the board shows; the site's when empty.

Objective.description: The weights candidates are ranked by.

TravelWeight.description: The weight of a short trip to the visit. Defaults to 5.

UrgencyWeight.description: The weight of starting soon, before the work order is due. Defaults to 3.

ProficiencyWeight.description: The weight of a skill level above the one needed. Defaults to 2.

PreferredWeight.description: The weight of a worker the work order prefers. Defaults to 4.

BalanceWeight.description: The weight of a worker with fewer visits that day. Defaults to 2.

AtRiskMinutes.description: How many minutes late a visit is at risk: running over, or not started. Defaults to 15.

OptimizerSeconds.description: How long the optimizer looks for a better plan, in seconds. Defaults to 5.

NoticesEnabled.description: Whether customers are told about their visit.

TrackingEnabled.description: Whether notices carry a link to follow the technician. Defaults to true.

ReminderHour.description: The local hour the reminders go out the day before, 0 to 23. Defaults to 17.

ScheduledText.description: The notice when a visit is scheduled or moved, with placeholders such as {Company}, {Number}, {Date} and {Window}.

ReminderText.description: The reminder the day before, with placeholders such as {Company}, {Date} and {Window}.

EnRouteText.description: The notice when the technician is on the way, with placeholders such as {Company}, {Technician}, {Eta} and {TrackingUrl}.

CompletedText.description: The notice when the visit is done, with placeholders such as {Company} and {Number}.

CanceledText.description: The notice when the visit is canceled, with placeholders such as {Company}, {Number} and {Date}.

BookingWorkOrderTypeId.description: The id of the work order type booked when a customer chooses an arrival window through Scheduling.

DisplayNameSettings.description: Configuration for how user display names are generated and which name fields are required.

Template.description: A Liquid template for generating custom display names when Type is 'Other'.

DisplayName.description: Whether the display name field is hidden, optional, or required.

FirstName.description: Whether the first name field is hidden, optional, or required.

LastName.description: Whether the last name field is hidden, optional, or required.

MiddleName.description: Whether the middle name field is hidden, optional, or required.

DncRegistrySettings.description: Configuration for globally enforcing do-not-call registry checks during content imports.

EnforceGlobally.description: Whether do-not-call registry checks are globally enforced for content imports.

EnforcedRegistryKeys.description: The registry keys that are always checked during content imports.

DownloadSettings.description: How long buyers' download links work, and how often, unless a product says otherwise.

DownloadLimit.description: How many times a buyer can download each file. Zero means no limit.

LinkLifetimeDays.description: How many days a buyer's links work. Zero means they never expire.

EasyPostSettings.description: The store's EasyPost account, on the EasyPost tab of Settings › Commerce › Shipping. The API key and the webhook secret are kept encrypted.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the store uses EasyPost as a carrier provider.

ApiKey.description: The EasyPost API key. It is stored encrypted with this tenant's data protection keys, so a plain value set by the Settings step can't be read: set it in the admin.

WebhookSecret.description: The secret EasyPost signs its tracking updates with, made when the webhook is registered. It is stored encrypted with this tenant's data protection keys, so a plain value set by the Settings step can't be read: set it in the admin.

WebhookId.description: EasyPost's id for the webhook registered for this site, or null.

WebhookUrl.description: The address the webhook was registered for.

Subject.description: The subject line for the verification email.

Body.description: The body template for the verification email. Use {{ Code }} for the verification code placeholder.

DefaultProviderName.description: The name of the default email provider.

ExportContentToDeploymentTargetSettings.description: Configuration for the export content to deployment target feature.

ExportContentToDeploymentTargetPlanId.description: The deployment plan ID used for exporting content.

UseExternalProviderIfOnlyOneDefined.description: Whether to automatically redirect to the external provider if only one is configured.

UseScriptToSyncProperties.description: Whether to use a script to synchronize user properties from external providers.

SyncPropertiesScript.description: The script used to synchronize user properties from external providers.

ExternalRegistrationSettings.description: Configuration for external authentication registration behavior.

DisableNewRegistrations.description: Whether to disable new user registrations via external providers.

NoPassword.description: Whether to skip requiring a password for externally authenticated users.

NoUsername.description: Whether to skip requiring a username for externally authenticated users.

NoEmail.description: Whether to skip requiring an email for externally authenticated users.

UseScriptToGenerateUsername.description: Whether to use a script to generate usernames for externally authenticated users.

GenerateUsernameScript.description: The script used to generate usernames for externally authenticated users.

CallbackPath.description: The request path within the application's base path where the user-agent will be returned after sign-in from Facebook.

SaveTokens.description: Whether to save the access and refresh tokens in the authentication properties.

ConversionsApiAccessToken.description: The access token of the Meta Conversions API, protected with the tenant's ASP.NET Core Data Protection keys. A clear value does not work.

ConversionsApiTestEventCode.description: The test event code sent with the Meta Conversions API events, to check them in the Events Manager.

FacebookSettings.description: Configuration for the Facebook social integration.

AppSecret.description: The Facebook application secret, protected with the tenant's ASP.NET Core Data Protection keys. A clear value does not work. In recipes, set 'AppSecretSecretName' instead.

AppSecretSecretName.description: The name of the secret (OrchardCore.Secrets feature) that holds the Facebook application secret. When it is set, it takes precedence over the protected value. Create the secret with the 'Secrets' recipe step.

FBInit.description: Whether to initialize the Facebook JavaScript SDK on the frontend.

FBInitParams.default:
status: true,
xfbml: true,
autoLogAppEvents: true

SdkJs.description: The name of the SDK JavaScript file to load.

Version.description: The Facebook Graph API version to use (e.g., v3.2).

FundraisingSettings.description: Who the receipts are from: the organization donations go to and what the receipt says.

OrganizationName.description: The name of the organization donations go to, printed on receipts.

TaxId.description: The organization's tax or charity registration number, printed on receipts.

ReceiptStatement.default: No goods or services were provided in exchange for this contribution.
ReceiptStatement.description: What the receipt says about the donation, such as that no goods or services were given in return.

EmailReceipts.description: Whether donors get their receipt by email when they give.

EnableAnalytics.description: Legacy and ignored. AI usage tracking is turned on by enabling the AI Usage Analytics feature.

EnableAIUsageTracking.description: Legacy and ignored. Kept so a stored value can be read by a migration; AI usage tracking is turned on by enabling the AI Usage Analytics feature.

EnablePreemptiveMemoryRetrieval.description: Whether to enable preemptive memory retrieval for AI sessions.

OverrideMaximumIterationsPerRequest.description: Whether to override the default maximum iterations per request.

MaximumIterationsPerRequest.description: The maximum number of tool-call iterations allowed per AI request.

OverrideEnableDistributedCaching.description: Whether to override the distributed caching setting.

EnableDistributedCaching.description: Whether to enable distributed caching for AI responses.

OverrideEnableOpenTelemetry.description: Whether to override the OpenTelemetry setting.

EnableOpenTelemetry.description: Whether to enable OpenTelemetry tracing for AI operations.

GeoSettings.description: The site's map, geocoding and travel-time settings.

GeocodingProvider.description: The geocoding provider; null for none. The name of a provider whose feature is on, such as GoogleMaps, AzureMaps or Osrm (OSRM gives travel times and routes only).

TravelTimeProvider.description: The travel-time provider; null for the built-in estimate from AverageSpeedKmh and RoadFactor. The name of a provider whose feature is on, such as GoogleMaps, AzureMaps or Osrm (OSRM gives travel times and routes only).

RouteProvider.description: The route provider; null to draw straight lines. The name of a provider whose feature is on, such as GoogleMaps, AzureMaps or Osrm (OSRM gives travel times and routes only).

AverageSpeedKmh.description: The average speed of the built-in estimate, in km/h. Defaults to 40.

RoadFactor.description: How much longer roads are than a straight line, for the built-in estimate. Defaults to 1.3.

MatrixCacheMinutes.description: How long travel times are cached, in minutes. Defaults to 60.

TileUrl.description: The map tile address, with {z}, {x} and {y}. Defaults to the OpenStreetMap tile server, for trying things out only.

DefaultLatitude.description: The latitude maps open at when there's nothing to show yet. Defaults to 39.5.

DefaultLongitude.description: The longitude maps open at when there's nothing to show yet. Defaults to -98.35.

DefaultZoom.description: The zoom maps open at when there's nothing to show yet. Defaults to 4.

ClientID.description: The Client ID from the GitHub OAuth application.

ClientSecret.description: The GitHub OAuth client secret, protected with the tenant's ASP.NET Core Data Protection keys. A clear value does not work. In recipes, set 'ClientSecretSecretName' instead.

ClientSecretSecretName.description: The name of the secret (OrchardCore.Secrets feature) that holds the GitHub OAuth client secret. When it is set, it takes precedence over the protected value. Create the secret with the 'Secrets' recipe step.

CallbackPath.description: The request path within the application's base path where the user-agent will be returned after sign-in from GitHub.

SaveTokens.description: Whether to save the access and refresh tokens in the authentication properties.

TrackingID.description: The Google Analytics tracking ID (e.g., G-XXXXXXXXXX).

ClientID.description: The Client ID from the Google Cloud Console.

ClientSecret.description: The Google client secret, protected with the tenant's ASP.NET Core Data Protection keys. A clear value does not work. In recipes, set 'ClientSecretSecretName' instead.

ClientSecretSecretName.description: The name of the secret (OrchardCore.Secrets feature) that holds the Google client secret. When it is set, it takes precedence over the protected value. Create the secret with the 'Secrets' recipe step.

CallbackPath.description: The request path where the user-agent will be returned after authentication.

SaveTokens.description: Whether to save the access and refresh tokens.

GoogleMapsSettings.description: The Google Maps provider's settings. Choose the provider in GeoSettings.

Key.description: The API key, stored encrypted with this tenant's data protection keys. A plain key written by the Settings step can't be read back, so enter the key in the admin under Settings > Maps and Geocoding instead.

GooglePlacesSettings.description: The Google Places address suggestions settings.

ApiKey.description: The Google Places API key, encrypted with the site's data protection keys. A clear-text key set by a recipe can't be read, so enter the key under Settings in the admin instead; a value exported from another site only works where the same data protection keys are used.

ContainerID.description: The Google Tag Manager container ID (e.g., GTM-XXXXXXX).

HttpsSettings.description: Configuration for HTTPS and strict transport security.

StrictTransportSecurityMode.description: Whether HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) headers are sent: never, always, or as the hosting configuration decides. Replaces the obsolete EnableStrictTransportSecurity property.

RequireHttps.description: Whether to require HTTPS for all requests.

RequireHttpsPermanent.description: Whether to use a permanent (301) redirect for HTTPS redirection.

SslPort.description: The port number for SSL connections.

InstallmentPlanSettings.description: The site settings for installment plans.

RetryDays.description: How many days after a failed automatic charge each retry is made, in order. Defaults to one, three and five days. After the last retry fails, the payment is left for the customer to pay.

DefaultCollectionMethod.description: The collection method a new plan starts with.

CheckoutSources.description: The transaction sources (Transaction.Source) whose balances a customer may choose to pay in installments at checkout. Empty, the default, offers installments only where a module offers them itself.

CheckoutInstallmentCounts.description: The numbers of payments a customer may choose from at checkout, for example 3 and 6.

CheckoutFrequency.description: How often the payments a customer chooses at checkout fall due.

CheckoutMinimumAmount.description: The smallest balance that may be paid in installments at checkout. Zero allows any balance.

InteractionDocumentSettings.description: Configuration for AI document retrieval during chat interactions.

IndexProfileName.description: The name of the index profile used for document retrieval.

TopN.description: The maximum number of document chunks to retrieve per query.

AllowDocumentUploads.description: Whether users can upload document files in chat interactions.

AllowImageUploads.description: Whether users can upload image files in chat interactions.

MaxIndexableCharacters.description: The most characters a document may hold; a longer document is refused at upload rather than stored unsearchable. AI profiles may override it.

DescribeFiguresInUploads.description: Whether figures in uploaded documents are described by the Vision deployment while they are indexed. AI profiles may override it.

DefaultLowStockThreshold.description: How few available units count as low stock for products without their own threshold.

HoldMinutes.description: How many minutes stock stays held for an order that hasn't been paid for. A payment that arrives later still sells the units, below zero if they were sold to someone else meanwhile.

LowStockNotificationRoles.description: The roles whose users are notified when a product runs low or sells out. Notifications need Orchard Core's Notifications feature.

LocationId.description: The location's identifier, which stock levels refer to. The default location is always present.

Name.description: The location's name, such as Main warehouse.

Address.description: Where the location is, on one line, for staff.

OwnerKind.description: The kind of record that owns the location, such as Asset for a van, or null for the site's own.

OwnerId.description: The record that owns the location.

Locations.description: The places stock is kept, in the order orders take units from them. The default location, where stock counted before there were locations is, is always one of them; see GetLocations.

Zones.description: The list of available zones for widget placement.

LocalizationSettings.description: Configuration for site localization and culture settings.

DefaultCulture.description: The default culture for the site (e.g., en-US).

FallBackToParentCulture.description: Whether to fall back to the parent culture when a translation is not found.

UseSiteTheme.description: Whether to use the site theme for the login page.

DisableLocalLogin.description: Whether to disable local username/password login.

AllowRememberMe.description: Whether to allow users to be remembered across browser sessions during login.

UsePersistentAuthenticationCookie.description: Whether the authentication cookie persists across browser sessions by default.

AllowChangingUsername.description: Whether to allow users to change their username.

AllowChangingEmail.description: Whether to allow users to change their email address.

AllowChangingPhoneNumber.description: Whether to allow users to change their phone number.

LoyaltySettings.description: How customers earn and spend loyalty points, under Settings > Commerce > Rewards.

ProgramName.description: What the program is called where buyers see it, such as "Rewards".

PointsPerUnit.description: The points earned for each unit of currency spent on goods, after discounts and before shipping and tax.

PointValue.description: What one point is worth when it's spent, in the checkout currency.

MinimumPointsToRedeem.description: The fewest points a buyer must have to spend them.

MarketplaceSettings.description: How the marketplace takes its commission and when it releases what vendors earn.

CommissionPercent.description: The percent the store keeps of each vendor's sale, unless the vendor has its own.

HoldDays.description: How many days a sale is held in escrow after it's paid, such as for returns.

ReleaseOnFulfillment.description: Whether a sale of goods is also held until its order is fulfilled.

AutomaticPayouts.description: Whether released earnings are paid out by themselves, rather than when the store chooses.

PayoutProvider.description: The name of the payout provider vendors are paid through, or null to use the only one enabled. When several are enabled and none is named, nothing is paid out.

DefaultCountry.description: The country a vendor's Stripe account is made in when the vendor names none.

McpServerSettings.description: How MCP clients sign in to the site's MCP server and which tools it exposes. Values in the shell configuration override these.

AuthenticationType.description: OpenId signs clients in with the site's OpenID server; ApiKey requires the API key below.

ApiKey.description: The API key clients send when AuthenticationType is ApiKey. It is stored and compared as given (not encrypted), so a recipe should not carry a production key.

RequireAccessPermission.description: Whether OpenId clients also need the AccessMcpServer permission.

ExposeAllTools.description: Whether every non-hidden tool and tool instance is exposed. When true, Tools is ignored.

Tools.description: The names of the tools and tool instances exposed when ExposeAllTools is false.

MemoryMetadata.description: Configuration for user memory in chat interactions.

EnableUserMemory.description: Whether to enable per-user memory in chat interactions.

EnableSessionMemory.description: Whether the assistant remembers the earlier parts of a long conversation: messages that fall out of the past-messages window are summarized and relevant older turns recalled.

EnablePastConversations.description: Whether the assistant can look up the signed-in user's past conversations with the same profile.

AppId.description: The Application (client) ID from the Microsoft app registration.

AppSecret.description: The Microsoft application (client) secret, protected with the tenant's ASP.NET Core Data Protection keys. A clear value does not work. In recipes, set 'AppSecretSecretName' instead.

AppSecretSecretName.description: The name of the secret (OrchardCore.Secrets feature) that holds the Microsoft application (client) secret. When it is set, it takes precedence over the protected value. Create the secret with the 'Secrets' recipe step.

CallbackPath.description: The request path within the application's base path where the user-agent will be returned after sign-in.

SaveTokens.description: Whether to save the access and refresh tokens in the authentication properties.

NLWebSettings.description: What the NLWeb endpoint searches and how it answers.

IndexProfileNames.description: The names of the search index profiles the endpoint searches.

ContentTypes.description: The content types the results may be. Empty allows every type.

MaxResults.description: The most results one answer returns.

DefaultMode.description: The mode used when a request names none.

AllowLegacyRequests.description: Whether requests in the older NLWeb format are accepted.

AllowCrossOrigin.description: Whether pages on other sites may call the endpoint.

RewriteQueries.description: Whether an AI model rewrites the question before the search.

RankResults.description: Whether an AI model ranks the results.

AllowSummarize.description: Whether the summarize mode is offered.

AllowGenerate.description: Whether the generate mode is offered.

DeploymentName.description: The name of the AI deployment used to rewrite, rank and answer.

DataSourceId.description: The id of the AI data source searched instead of the index profiles.

OpenIdClientSettings.description: Configuration for OpenID Connect client authentication.

DisplayName.description: The display name for the OpenID Connect login provider.

Authority.description: The URI of the OpenID Connect identity provider.

ClientId.description: The client identifier registered with the identity provider.

ClientSecret.description: The OpenID Connect client secret, protected with the tenant's ASP.NET Core Data Protection keys. A clear value does not work. In recipes, set 'ClientSecretSecretName' instead.

ClientSecretSecretName.description: The name of the secret (OrchardCore.Secrets feature) that holds the OpenID Connect client secret. When it is set, it takes precedence over the protected value. Create the secret with the 'Secrets' recipe step.

CallbackPath.description: The request path within the application's base path where the user-agent will be returned.

SignedOutRedirectUri.description: The URI to redirect to after signing out.

SignedOutCallbackPath.description: The request path for the signed-out callback.

Scopes.description: The scopes to request from the identity provider.

ResponseType.description: The response type expected from the identity provider (e.g., 'code', 'id_token token').

ResponseMode.description: The response mode used when communicating with the identity provider.

StoreExternalTokens.description: Whether to store external tokens for later retrieval.

Parameters.description: Additional parameters to send to the identity provider.

OpenIdSecretSettings.description: The secrets that hold the signing and encryption keys of the OpenID Connect server (OrchardCore.OpenId.Secrets feature). A referenced secret takes precedence over the certificates of the OpenIdServerSettings.

SigningKeySecretName.description: The name of the RsaKeySecret or X509Secret that holds the key used to sign tokens.

EncryptionKeySecretName.description: The name of the RsaKeySecret or X509Secret that holds the key used to encrypt tokens.

OpenIdServerSettings.description: Configuration for the OpenID Connect server.

AccessTokenFormat.description: The format used to create access tokens.

Authority.description: The base URI of the OpenID Connect server.

DisableAccessTokenEncryption.description: Whether to disable access token encryption.

EncryptionCertificateStoreLocation.description: The X.509 certificate store location for the encryption certificate.

EncryptionCertificateStoreName.description: The X.509 certificate store name for the encryption certificate.

EncryptionCertificateThumbprint.description: The thumbprint of the X.509 encryption certificate.

SigningCertificateStoreLocation.description: The X.509 certificate store location for the signing certificate.

SigningCertificateStoreName.description: The X.509 certificate store name for the signing certificate.

SigningCertificateThumbprint.description: The thumbprint of the X.509 signing certificate.

AuthorizationEndpointPath.description: The relative path of the authorization endpoint.

LogoutEndpointPath.description: The relative path of the logout endpoint.

TokenEndpointPath.description: The relative path of the token endpoint.

UserinfoEndpointPath.description: The relative path of the userinfo endpoint.

IntrospectionEndpointPath.description: The relative path of the introspection endpoint.

PushedAuthorizationEndpointPath.description: The relative path of the pushed authorization (PAR) endpoint.

RevocationEndpointPath.description: The relative path of the revocation endpoint.

AllowPasswordFlow.description: Whether to allow the resource owner password credentials grant.

AllowClientCredentialsFlow.description: Whether to allow the client credentials grant.

AllowAuthorizationCodeFlow.description: Whether to allow the authorization code grant.

AllowRefreshTokenFlow.description: Whether to allow refresh token grants.

AllowHybridFlow.description: Whether to allow the hybrid flow.

AllowImplicitFlow.description: Whether to allow the implicit flow.

DisableRollingRefreshTokens.description: Whether to disable rolling refresh tokens.

UseReferenceAccessTokens.description: Whether to use reference access tokens instead of self-contained tokens.

RequireProofKeyForCodeExchange.description: Whether to require PKCE for authorization code flow.

RequirePushedAuthorizationRequests.description: Whether to require pushed authorization requests (PAR).

RequireEndSessionConfirmation.description: Whether the logout endpoint asks the user to confirm the sign-out. When false, the user is signed out without a confirmation page.

OpenIdValidationSettings.description: Configuration for OpenID Connect token validation.

Audience.description: The audience (resource identifier) that this application accepts tokens for.

Authority.description: The URI of the OpenID Connect identity provider used to validate tokens.

DisableTokenTypeValidation.description: Whether to disable token type validation.

Tenant.description: The tenant name to use for local token validation.

MetadataAddress.description: The URI of the OpenID Connect discovery document.

OrderEmailTemplateSettings.description: The store's templates of its emails, of every kind (Settings › Commerce › Emails). The class keeps the name it had when it served orders only, because the site stores its settings under the class name: renaming it would lose the templates a store wrote and break its recipes and deployment plans.

Layout.description: The HTML around every email with a kind, with {{ Content }} where the email goes, such as the store's logo and address; empty for none.

Subject.description: The subject, with Liquid; the email's own when empty.

Body.description: The body, as HTML with Liquid; {{ Content }} is the email as the store would send it.

Templates.description: Each email's own template, by its kind.

OrderSettings.description: How the store handles orders, under Settings › Commerce › Orders.

SendConfirmations.description: Whether a paid order's confirmation is emailed to the customer. It is sent only when the site has an email service.

AllowQuoteRequests.description: Whether signed-in buyers may ask for a quote from their cart instead of checking out.

SendRecoveryEmails.description: Whether a buyer who leaves a checkout without paying is emailed once, with what they chose and a link back to it. It is sent only when the site has an email service.

RecoveryDelayHours.description: How many hours after the checkout was left the recovery email goes out.

OrderBumpProductId.description: The product offered at checkout as an order bump: one tick adds it to the order before paying.

OrderBumpPercentOff.description: How much less the order bump costs than the product's price, in percent, or null.

OrderBumpHeadline.description: What the offer says above the product, such as "Add a matching cap?".

OsrmSettings.description: The settings of the OSRM routing server used for travel times and routes. Choose the provider in GeoSettings.

BaseUrl.description: The server's address, such as http://localhost:5000.

Profile.description: The routing profile the server was built with. Defaults to driving.

PayLaterSettings.description: The site settings that control how Pay Later commitments become outstanding transactions.

Enabled.description: Whether Pay Later is offered at checkout. Off by default, so a store doesn't let every shopper order without paying until it chooses to.

NetTermDays.description: The number of days a Pay Later balance is allowed before it is due. When greater than zero the outstanding transaction is created with a due date this many days after checkout, which drives the reminder cadence. A value of 0 leaves the balance without a due date. Defaults to 30.

PhoneNumberVerificationsSettings.description: How and how often phone numbers are verified.

RevalidationIntervalDays.description: The number of days after which a verified phone number is verified again.

MaxVerificationAttempts.description: The number of failed attempts in a row after which a record is no longer retried automatically and waits to be queued again by hand.

RequestDelayMilliseconds.description: The delay, in milliseconds, between two provider requests during background verification, to stay under the provider's rate limits.

SelectedProvider.description: The key of the provider that verifies phone numbers. The provider's feature must be enabled and the provider enabled in its own settings.

DefaultBrand.description: The brand of products that name none, such as the store's own.

DefaultCondition.description: The condition of products that name none: new, refurbished or used.

DefaultGoogleProductCategory.description: The Google product category of products that name none, as its id or full path.

IncludeOutOfStock.description: Whether products that are out of stock stay in the feed, marked so.

Key.description: A key the feed's address has to carry (?key=...), or none for a public feed.

PromptSecurityOptions.description: Configuration for AI chat prompt security and abuse throttling.

MaxPromptLength.description: The maximum allowed prompt length in characters.

EnableInjectionDetection.description: Whether prompt injection detection is enabled.

EnableSecurityPreamble.description: Whether the hardened security preamble is enabled.

EnableInputDelimiters.description: Whether user input delimiters are enabled.

EnableChatInteractionInputDelimiters.description: Whether user messages in Chat Interactions are wrapped with boundary delimiters. Chat Interactions get no security preamble or injection blocking.

EnableAuditLogging.description: Whether security audit logging is enabled.

BlockingThreshold.description: The minimum prompt risk level that triggers blocking, after weighted scoring.

LowRiskScoreThreshold.description: The aggregate score from which a prompt is suspicious (low risk).

MediumRiskScoreThreshold.description: The aggregate score from which a prompt is medium risk.

HighRiskScoreThreshold.description: The aggregate score from which a prompt is high risk.

CriticalRiskScoreThreshold.description: The aggregate score from which a prompt is critical risk.

CustomBlockedPatterns.description: Extra regular expressions detected in user prompts. A match scores as critical and is blocked by the default thresholds.

MaxMessagesPerWindow.description: The maximum number of messages allowed within the rate-limit window.

RateLimitWindow.description: The chat message rate-limit window as a .NET TimeSpan string.

AnonymousMessageRateLimitTiers.description: The multi-tier sliding-window message limits applied to anonymous callers. A message is throttled when it would exceed any tier. When empty, anonymous callers fall back to MaxMessagesPerWindow and RateLimitWindow.

Limit.description: The maximum number of events allowed within the window.

Window.description: The sliding-window duration as a .NET TimeSpan string.

MaxAnonymousSessionsPerWindow.description: The maximum number of anonymous sessions allowed within the anonymous session-start window. Used only as a fallback when AnonymousSessionStartRateLimitTiers is empty.

AnonymousSessionRateLimitWindow.description: The anonymous session-start rate-limit window as a .NET TimeSpan string.

AnonymousSessionStartRateLimitTiers.description: The multi-tier sliding-window limits applied to anonymous session starts. A session start is throttled when it would exceed any tier. When empty, anonymous session starts fall back to MaxAnonymousSessionsPerWindow and AnonymousSessionRateLimitWindow.

Limit.description: The maximum number of events allowed within the window.

Window.description: The sliding-window duration as a .NET TimeSpan string.

ReCaptchaScriptUri.description: The URI for the reCAPTCHA JavaScript script.

ReCaptchaApiUri.description: The URI for the reCAPTCHA verification API.

ReceiptSettings.description: The site settings that brand every receipt the tenant issues. These are merged into each built receipt document so consumers never embed issuer branding themselves.

HeaderTitle.description: The heading printed at the top of every receipt (for example "Payment receipt").

BusinessName.description: The issuing business name. When empty, the site name is used as a fallback.

LogoUrl.description: The URL of the issuing business logo.

BusinessAddress.description: The issuing business postal address, printed as free-form text.

ContactEmail.description: The issuing business contact email address.

ContactPhone.description: The issuing business contact phone number.

FooterText.description: The footer text printed at the bottom of every receipt.

ShowTestPaymentBadge.description: Whether a test-payment badge is shown when a payment ran in a gateway test mode. Defaults to true.

ReferralSettings.description: What a referred friend gets and what the customer who referred them gets, under Settings > Commerce > Referrals.

FriendCouponId.description: The coupon each referred friend gets a single-use code of, or null for none.

RewardKind.description: What the customer who referred a friend gets for the friend's first order: None, StoreCredit (RewardAmount) or Points (RewardPoints).

RewardAmount.description: The store credit the customer gets for a friend's first order, in the checkout currency.

RewardPoints.description: The loyalty points the customer gets for a friend's first order.

MinimumOrderAmount.description: The least a friend's first order must spend on goods for the customer to be rewarded.

UsersMustValidateEmail.description: Whether users must validate their email address before activation.

UsersAreModerated.description: Whether new user registrations require administrator approval.

UseSiteTheme.description: Whether to use the site theme for the registration page.

ResetPasswordSettings.description: Configuration for the password reset feature.

AllowResetPassword.description: Whether to allow users to reset their password.

UseSiteTheme.description: Whether to use the site theme for the reset password page.

WindowDays.description: For how many days after an order is paid its buyer can ask to return items.

Reasons.description: The reasons a buyer chooses from when asking for a return. Empty offers the defaults: Doesn't fit, Not as described, Arrived damaged, Changed my mind and Other.

AllowExchanges.description: Whether a buyer can ask for something else instead of their money back.

Instructions.description: What the buyer is told once the return is approved, such as where to send the items.

ReverseProxySettings.description: Configuration for reverse proxy header forwarding.

KnownNetworks.description: The list of known network addresses.

KnownProxies.description: The list of known proxy IP addresses.

ReviewSettings.description: How product reviews are collected and shown.

RequireApproval.description: Whether a review waits for the store to approve it before it shows.

BuyersOnly.description: Whether only buyers who paid for the product can review it.

SendReviewRequests.description: Whether buyers who accept marketing are emailed, some days after paying, to review what they bought.

ReviewRequestDelayDays.description: The days after an order is paid its review request goes, such as 14 for time to use what came.

RobotsSettings.description: Configuration for the robots.txt file generation.

AllowAllAgents.description: Whether to allow all user agents.

DisallowAdmin.description: Whether to disallow crawling the admin area.

AdditionalRules.description: Additional custom rules appended to the robots.txt file.

RoleLoginSettings.description: Configuration for role-based two-factor authentication requirements.

RequireTwoFactorAuthenticationForSpecifi.description: Whether to require two-factor authentication for specific roles.

Roles.description: The roles that require two-factor authentication.

SearchSettings.description: Configuration for the site search feature.

DefaultIndexProfileName.description: The name of the default search index profile.

Placeholder.description: The placeholder text for the search input.

PageTitle.description: The title displayed on the search results page.

SecureCaptureSettings.description: Policy for agent-assisted secure data capture, where the customer enters sensitive data through a one-time link instead of speaking it.

Enabled.description: Whether agents may start a secure capture. When false the platform refuses a capture regardless of permission or provider capability.

LinkTimeToLiveSeconds.description: Lifetime, in seconds, of the one-time customer capture link.

PauseRecordingDuringCapture.description: Whether starting a capture pauses call recording for its duration.

WeightUnit.description: The unit product weights and weight tables are in.

ShippingClasses.description: The shipping classes products can be in, such as Bulky, which methods can charge extra for.

Name.description: The carrier's name, such as UPS.

TrackingUrlTemplate.description: The tracking link, with {0} where the tracking number goes.

Carriers.description: The carriers shipments are sent with, each with the link its parcels are tracked at.

SendShippedEmails.description: Whether the buyer gets an email, with the tracking link, when a shipment is marked shipped.

LocationId.description: The location's identifier, which orders refer to.

Name.description: The name buyers see, such as Downtown store.

AddressLine1.description: The street address of the location.

Region.description: The state, province or region of the location.

PostalCode.description: The postal code of the location.

Instructions.description: What the buyer is told, such as opening hours or "ready in 2 hours".

Fee.description: What picking up from the location costs; zero for free.

StockLocationId.description: The inventory location the order's units come from, or null to let inventory choose.

PickupLocations.description: The store's locations buyers can pick their order up from, instead of having it shipped.

DefaultParcelLength.description: The size of the box most orders go in, in centimeters for a store weighing in kilograms and inches otherwise, which carriers quote with.

DefaultParcelWidth.description: The width of the default box, in the same unit as DefaultParcelLength.

DefaultParcelHeight.description: The height of the default box, in the same unit as DefaultParcelLength.

PackagingWeight.description: The weight of the box and packing, added to the items' weight, in the store's weight unit.

SitemapsRobotsSettings.description: Configuration for including sitemaps in the robots.txt file.

IncludeSitemaps.description: Whether to include sitemap URLs in the robots.txt file.

Body.description: The body template for the verification SMS message.

DefaultProviderName.description: The name of the default SMS provider.

SmtpSettings.description: Configuration for the SMTP email provider.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the SMTP email provider is enabled.

AutoSelectEncryption.description: Whether to automatically select the encryption method.

RequireCredentials.description: Whether the SMTP server requires authentication.

UseDefaultCredentials.description: Whether to use the default system credentials.

EncryptionMethod.description: The encryption method for the SMTP connection.

Password.description: The SMTP password, protected with the tenant's ASP.NET Core Data Protection keys. A clear value does not work. In recipes, set 'PasswordSecretName' instead.

PasswordSecretName.description: The name of the secret (OrchardCore.Secrets feature) that holds the SMTP password. When it is set, it takes precedence over the protected value. Create the secret with the 'Secrets' recipe step.

IgnoreInvalidSslCertificate.description: Whether to ignore invalid SSL certificates.

DeliveryMethod.description: The delivery method for sending emails.

PickupDirectoryLocation.description: The directory path for storing emails when using the pickup directory delivery method.

SoftPhoneWidgetSettings.description: Where the soft phone widget is shown and how it looks.

Enabled.description: Kill switch for the soft phone widget. When false the widget, its styles and its scripts are not rendered anywhere on the site.

DisplayOnAdmin.description: Whether the floating soft phone widget is shown on the admin dashboard.

EnableDiagnostics.description: Whether the soft phone's Diagnostics tab (live media stats, microphone meter, provider warnings and the audio test) is shown.

AccentColor.description: Accent color of the widget, as a CSS color value.

RecentCallsCount.description: Maximum number of calls shown in the recent-calls history.

DefaultCountryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country the phone number input selects initially. When empty, the country is derived from the request culture.

StoreProfileSettings.description: Who the store is (Settings › Commerce › Store): its name, logo, tax ID, how to reach it and where it is. Receipts, the address parcels ship from and the tax origin fall back to it when their own settings are empty.

Name.description: The store's name, such as the business's legal or trading name; the site's name when empty.

LogoUrl.description: The address of the store's logo, such as a media library path or an absolute URL.

TaxId.description: The store's tax ID, such as a VAT, GST or EIN number.

Email.description: The e-mail address customers reach the store at.

Phone.description: The phone number customers reach the store at, in E.164 form when it parses.

Name.description: The recipient full name (the person or attention line the address is addressed to).

Company.description: The company or organization name, when the address belongs to a business.

AddressLine1.description: The first street line (street number and name, or PO box).

AddressLine2.description: The second street line (apartment, suite, unit, or building), when present.

DependentLocality.description: The part of the city the address is in, for the countries whose post uses one: a suburb, a neighbourhood (a Brazilian bairro), or a Chinese or Korean district.

SortingCode.description: The sorting code a few countries add after the city, such as the French CEDEX.

Country.description: The ISO country code (for example US or CA).

Region.description: The state, province or region. For a country with a list of regions it is the region's code: its ISO 3166-2 code without the country (CA for California, 13 for Tokyo), or the key the country's post uses when there is no ISO code.

District.description: The special or tax district identifier.

Phone.description: The contact phone number for the address, used for delivery and fulfillment.

Latitude.description: The latitude of the address, when it was geocoded or pinned on a map.

Longitude.description: The longitude of the address, when it was geocoded or pinned on a map.

GeocodeSource.description: Where the coordinates came from: a geocoding provider's name, or Manual when pinned.

StripeSettings.description: Stores tenant-level Stripe configuration used by checkout and webhook processing.

IsLive.description: Whether live Stripe credentials are active.

LivePrivateSecret.description: The live Stripe secret key. Use the StripeSettings recipe step to set it from a recipe. It is stored encrypted with this tenant's data protection keys, so a plain value set by the Settings step can't be read: set it in the admin.

LiveWebhookSecret.description: The live Stripe webhook signing secret. Use the StripeSettings recipe step to set it from a recipe. It is stored encrypted with this tenant's data protection keys, so a plain value set by the Settings step can't be read: set it in the admin.

LiveAccountId.description: The identifier of the live Stripe account resolved when the live secret key was verified.

LiveWebhookId.description: The identifier of the live webhook endpoint provisioned automatically when connecting.

TestPrivateSecret.description: The test Stripe secret key. Use the StripeSettings recipe step to set it from a recipe. It is stored encrypted with this tenant's data protection keys, so a plain value set by the Settings step can't be read: set it in the admin.

TestWebhookSecret.description: The test Stripe webhook signing secret. Use the StripeSettings recipe step to set it from a recipe. It is stored encrypted with this tenant's data protection keys, so a plain value set by the Settings step can't be read: set it in the admin.

TestAccountId.description: The identifier of the test Stripe account resolved when the test secret key was verified.

TestWebhookId.description: The identifier of the test webhook endpoint provisioned automatically when connecting.

RenderOnPages.description: Whether the structured data is rendered on the site's pages.

PublisherType.description: Whether the site is published by an organization or a person, or empty (or null) to describe no publisher.

PublisherName.description: The publisher's name. The site name is used when it is empty.

PublisherLogoUrl.description: The URL of the publisher's logo.

SameAs.description: The URLs of the publisher's profiles on other sites.

IncludeWebSite.description: Whether a WebSite entry is rendered on the home page.

IncludeSearchAction.description: Whether the WebSite entry carries a search action.

SubscriptionOnboardingSettings.description: Represents tenant onboarding settings used by subscription flows that provision sites.

DatabaseProvider.description: The database provider every provisioned site is created with.

ProtectedConnectionString.description: The connection string provisioned sites are created with. It is stored encrypted with this tenant's data protection keys, so a plain value set by the Settings step can't be read: set it in the admin.

Schema.description: The schema provisioned sites are created in, when the provider supports one.

SubscriptionRoleSettings.description: Represents role assignment settings for users created during subscription registration.

RoleNames.description: The role names assigned to newly created subscription users.

SubscriptionSettings.description: Represents site-level settings for subscription checkout and billing.

Currency.description: The ISO currency code used for subscription invoices and payments.

AllowGuestSignup.description: Whether subscribers may complete checkout as guests.

DunningGraceDays.description: How many days a subscriber keeps access after a renewal payment fails.

TaxJarSettings.description: The TaxJar account sales tax is worked out with, under Commerce › Taxation › TaxJar.

ApiKey.description: The TaxJar API token. It is stored encrypted with this tenant's data protection keys, so a plain value set by the Settings step can't be read: set it in the admin.

UseSandbox.description: Whether TaxJar's sandbox answers, for a sandbox token.

Countries.description: The two-letter codes of the countries TaxJar works tax out for; orders to the others are taxed by the store's own rules.

TaxOriginSettings.description: Where the store sells from. Taxes sourced at the origin, such as some states' sales tax, use it when an item doesn't say where it ships from.

Name.description: The recipient full name (the person or attention line the address is addressed to).

Company.description: The company or organization name, when the address belongs to a business.

AddressLine1.description: The first street line (street number and name, or PO box).

AddressLine2.description: The second street line (apartment, suite, unit, or building), when present.

DependentLocality.description: The part of the city the address is in, for the countries whose post uses one: a suburb, a neighbourhood (a Brazilian bairro), or a Chinese or Korean district.

SortingCode.description: The sorting code a few countries add after the city, such as the French CEDEX.

Country.description: The ISO country code (for example US or CA).

Region.description: The state, province or region. For a country with a list of regions it is the region's code: its ISO 3166-2 code without the country (CA for California, 13 for Tokyo), or the key the country's post uses when there is no ISO code.

District.description: The special or tax district identifier.

Phone.description: The contact phone number for the address, used for delivery and fulfillment.

Latitude.description: The latitude of the address, when it was geocoded or pinned on a map.

Longitude.description: The longitude of the address, when it was geocoded or pinned on a map.

GeocodeSource.description: Where the coordinates came from: a geocoding provider's name, or Manual when pinned.

Origin.description: The store's address, or null when it isn't set.

TaxonomyContentsAdminListSettings.description: Configuration for taxonomy filters in the content admin list.

TaxonomyContentItemIds.description: The content item IDs of taxonomies to use as filters.

TelephonySettings.description: Telephony settings shared by every phone system provider.

DefaultProviderName.description: Technical name of the telephony provider used when no provider is requested explicitly.

items.description: A short code the tenant may dial.

AllowedShortCodes.description: Short codes the tenant may dial even though they are not international numbers, for example a carrier service code. Emergency codes are never dialable.

TelnyxSettings.description: Telnyx voice provider settings. Telnyx authenticates every REST call with one tenant API key.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the Telnyx provider is enabled.

ApiKey.description: Telnyx API key (v2), presented as a bearer token on every REST call. Secret: stored exactly as given, so it must already be data-protected by the destination tenant. Prefer the provider's own recipe step, which takes the value in clear text and protects it.

ConnectionId.description: Identifier of the Telnyx Call Control (Voice API) application used to place and control calls. It is provisioned by the Connect action and belongs to one Telnyx account.

SipConnectionId.description: Optional Telnyx Credential (SIP) connection browser credentials are issued against. When empty, 'ConnectionId' is used.

OutboundVoiceProfileId.description: Optional outbound voice profile applied to outbound calls when the connection does not bind one.

CredentialLifetimeMinutes.description: Browser SIP credential lifetime, in minutes.

DefaultOutboundCallerId.description: Default E.164 caller identifier presented on outbound calls when no other caller identifier applies.

WebhookPublicKey.description: Telnyx webhook Ed25519 public key (base64) used to verify inbound webhook signatures. Inbound webhooks are rejected while it is empty. Secret: stored exactly as given, so it must already be data-protected by the destination tenant. Prefer the provider's own recipe step, which takes the value in clear text and protects it.

ApiBaseUrl.description: Optional override of the Telnyx REST API base address. Empty uses https://api.telnyx.com/v2/.

SipWebSocketUrl.description: SIP-over-WebSocket signaling URL browser soft phones register against. Empty uses wss://sip.telnyx.com:7443.

SipDomain.description: SIP domain browser credentials register under. Empty uses sip.telnyx.com.

WebRtcCodecs.description: Comma- or space-separated preferred WebRTC audio codecs advertised to the browser.

WebRtcRegion.description: Telnyx signaling region browser soft phones register on. Empty lets Telnyx geo-routing choose.

IceUrls.description: Comma- or space-separated STUN/TURN URLs advertised to the browser. Empty advertises a default Telnyx STUN server.

TurnUsername.description: Optional TURN user name advertised alongside 'IceUrls'.

TurnCredential.description: Optional TURN credential advertised alongside 'IceUrls'. Secret: stored exactly as given, so it must already be data-protected by the destination tenant. Prefer the provider's own recipe step, which takes the value in clear text and protects it.

IceTransportPolicy.description: ICE transport policy advertised to the browser, for example 'all' or 'relay'.

EchoTestDestination.description: Optional echo destination (a number or SIP URI that echoes audio back) used by the audio test and the health canary.

OrphanedCallHandling.description: What to do about a call the connection has up that the platform has no record of: record it and leave it connected, or tell the caller and hang up.

AnsweringMachineDetection.description: How an automated call asks the provider whether a person or a machine answered it.

NoiseSuppressionEngine.description: The Telnyx noise suppression engine started on an agent's leg once it is connected, or 'Off'.

NoiseSuppressionAgentVoice.description: Whether noise suppression cleans the agent's voice, which is what the caller hears.

NoiseSuppressionCallerVoice.description: Whether noise suppression cleans the caller's voice, which is what the agent hears.

NoiseSuppressionStrength.description: How hard the noise suppression engine works on each voice it cleans. 'Balanced' (the default) removes line hiss while keeping the soft endings of words.

TtsVoice.description: Text-to-speech voice used by spoken prompts, either 'female', 'male' or a 'Provider.Model.VoiceId' name such as 'AWS.Polly.Joanna-Neural'.

TtsLanguage.description: Language spoken prompts are said in, for example 'en-US'.

TelnyxSmsSettings.description: Telnyx SMS provider settings, independent of the Telnyx voice settings.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the UI-configured Telnyx SMS provider is enabled.

ApiKey.description: Telnyx API key (v2) presented as a bearer token on the Messaging API. Secret: stored exactly as given, so it must already be data-protected by the destination tenant. Prefer the provider's own recipe step, which takes the value in clear text and protects it.

MessagingProfileId.description: Optional Telnyx messaging profile identifier used when sending.

WebhookPublicKey.description: Telnyx webhook Ed25519 public key (base64) used to verify inbound messaging webhooks. Secret: stored exactly as given, so it must already be data-protected by the destination tenant. Prefer the provider's own recipe step, which takes the value in clear text and protects it.

ApiBaseUrl.description: Optional override of the Telnyx REST API base address. Empty uses https://api.telnyx.com/v2/.

TransactionReminderSettings.description: The site settings that control how outstanding-payment reminders are sent for the tenant. Reminders are delivered through the notification system so each user receives them on their preferred channel.

Enabled.description: Whether the scheduled reminder sweep is enabled. Defaults to true.

FirstReminderDelayDays.description: The number of days to wait after a transaction becomes due before the first reminder is sent. Defaults to 0 (remind as soon as it is due).

ReminderIntervalDays.description: The number of days to wait between reminders. Defaults to 7.

MaxReminders.description: The maximum number of reminders to send for a single transaction. Defaults to 3. A value of 0 or less means there is no limit.

UpcomingReminderDays.description: How many days before a payment falls due the owner is told it is coming due. One such reminder is sent per transaction. Defaults to 3. A value of 0 or less turns these reminders off.

TwilioPhoneNumberVerificationSettings.description: The Twilio Lookup phone number verification provider.
