IsEnabled.description: Whether the provider is enabled and can be selected to verify phone numbers.

AuthenticationType.description: How the provider authenticates: with an API key SID and secret, or with the account SID and auth token.

ApiKeySid.description: The API key SID, used with ApiKey authentication.

ProtectedApiKeySecret.description: The API key secret, used with ApiKey authentication. The Settings step stores it exactly as given, so it must already be encrypted by the destination tenant with the 'PhoneNumberVerifications.Twilio' data protection purpose; a clear-text value cannot be read. Prefer entering it on the settings screen.

AccountSid.description: The account SID, used with AccountCredentials authentication.

ProtectedAuthToken.description: The auth token, used with AccountCredentials authentication. The Settings step stores it exactly as given, so it must already be encrypted by the destination tenant with the 'PhoneNumberVerifications.Twilio' data protection purpose; a clear-text value cannot be read. Prefer entering it on the settings screen.

CountryCode.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code used when a number is given in national format, such as 'US'.

Fields.description: The comma-separated Lookup data packages requested with each lookup, such as 'line_type_intelligence'.

TwilioSettings.description: Configuration for the Twilio SMS provider.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the Twilio SMS provider is enabled.

PhoneNumber.description: The Twilio phone number to send SMS messages from.

AuthToken.description: The Twilio auth token, protected with the tenant's ASP.NET Core Data Protection keys. A clear value does not work. In recipes, set 'AuthTokenSecretName' instead.

AuthTokenSecretName.description: The name of the secret (OrchardCore.Secrets feature) that holds the Twilio auth token. When it is set, it takes precedence over the protected value. Create the secret with the 'Secrets' recipe step.

ConsumerKey.description: The API key (consumer key) from the Twitter developer application.

ConsumerSecret.description: The Twitter API secret key (consumer secret), protected with the tenant's ASP.NET Core Data Protection keys. A clear value does not work. In recipes, set 'ConsumerSecretSecretName' instead.

ConsumerSecretSecretName.description: The name of the secret (OrchardCore.Secrets feature) that holds the Twitter API secret key (consumer secret). When it is set, it takes precedence over the protected value. Create the secret with the 'Secrets' recipe step.

AccessToken.description: The access token for authenticating API requests.

AccessTokenSecret.description: The Twitter access token secret, protected with the tenant's ASP.NET Core Data Protection keys. A clear value does not work. In recipes, set 'AccessTokenSecretSecretName' instead.

AccessTokenSecretSecretName.description: The name of the secret (OrchardCore.Secrets feature) that holds the Twitter access token secret. When it is set, it takes precedence over the protected value. Create the secret with the 'Secrets' recipe step.

CallbackPath.description: The request path where the user-agent will be returned after authentication.

SaveTokens.description: Whether to save the access and refresh tokens.

RequireTwoFactorAuthentication.description: Whether to require two-factor authentication for all users.

AllowRememberClientTwoFactorAuthenticati.description: Whether to allow users to remember their two-factor authentication on a device.

NumberOfRecoveryCodesToGenerate.description: The number of recovery codes to generate.

UseSiteTheme.description: Whether to use the site theme for the two-factor authentication pages.

UsaFtcDncRegistrySettings.description: Configuration for the USA FTC Do Not Call Registry provider.

ProtectedApiKey.description: The encrypted API key used to authenticate with the USA FTC Do Not Call Registry.

OrganizationId.description: The USA FTC organization identifier used for registry lookups.

BaseUrl.description: The base URL for the USA FTC Do Not Call Registry API.

Required.description: Whether users are required to upload an avatar.

UseDefaultStyle.description: Whether to use the default avatar styling.

VeriphonePhoneNumberVerificationSettings.description: The Veriphone phone number verification provider.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the provider is enabled and can be selected to verify phone numbers.

ProtectedApiKey.description: The API key. The Settings step stores it exactly as given, so it must already be encrypted by the destination tenant with the 'PhoneNumberVerifications.Veriphone' data protection purpose; a clear-text value cannot be read. Prefer entering it on the settings screen.

WebMcpSettings.description: Which tools the site gives to browser agents through WebMCP, and on which pages.

ExposeAllTools.description: Whether every selectable tool and tool instance is given to browser agents. When true, Tools is ignored.

Tools.description: The names of the tools and tool instances given to browser agents when ExposeAllTools is false.

EnableOnAdminPages.description: Whether admin pages offer WebMCP tools.

EnableOnFrontEndPages.description: Whether front-end pages offer WebMCP tools.

EnablePageTools.description: Whether the pages that get WebMCP also get the page tools, which read the page, list its links, open another page of the site, and read and fill its forms.

WorkflowTrimmingSettings.description: Configuration for automatic trimming of old workflow instances.

RetentionDays.description: The number of days to retain workflow instances before trimming.

Disabled.description: Whether automatic workflow trimming is disabled.

Statuses.description: The workflow statuses to include in trimming.
